buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1 . The bidder is required to accept Additional Term & Condition (ATC) & Specification of article and attach declaration on Letter Head duly signed & stamped by authorized person and upload it on GeM Portal while submitting Tender documents. 2. The Bidder should not Banned or Suspended or Blacklisted from any organization. Attach supporting dec laration regarding above on His Letter Head. 3 . The bidder must attach valid documents in support to their technical and financial capability. Without p roper supporting documents, the bid proposals are liable to be rejected. 4. When bidder submits his tender in response to tender documents, he will be deemed to have understo od fully all requirements, term and conditions, No request will be entertained on a pretext that the tendere r did not have a clear idea on any particular point and / or a clause of the tender. 5. No enhancement of rates will be allowed once the financial bid accepted and the order is placed. 6. No advance payment will be made to the supplier. 100% payment will be made within 45 days subject t o receipt of items by this Division Office. 7. Advance sample of Lunch Box will have to be delivered to below address prior or on the opening date of Technical bid. Manager (Sales) LIC OF INDIA – Prayagraj Division Office, Jeevan Prakash 172A/40, M.G MARG, Civil Lines

Prayagraj-211001 Mob.No-9839079467 Submission of Sample is mandatory condition, failing to which shall attract disqualify. 8. Price and delivery quoted by the bidder will be valid for Bid Validity period from the date of opening of Fi nancial Bid. 9. In case, due to some unforeseen circumstances, the date of delivery/ receiving of items happen to be a holiday/ closed day, the items will be delivered on next working day within working hours i.e 10:00 h to 17: 30 h. 10. The quoted price by bidder should be all inclusive of following a. Transportation charges. b. Loading / unloading charges. c. All Taxes, GST, Duties, Other Charges if any 11. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP addresses used by t he Buyer and t he Bidder(s) /Seller(s). The received bids having Matching /common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller( s) will disqualify. 12. TDS shall be deducted as per rules. 13. Supply of the article has to be made within the given time frame at Divisional Office, Prayagraj on abov e address on supplier cost. 14. In case of delay in supply of order, the penalty clause shall be applicable as mentioned in the Contract, however the competent authority can relax this condition if the cause of delay is due to the reason to the s atisfaction of the competent authority and the same may be communicated well in advance with full detail s. Any Bid not in compliance with these terms and conditions will be liable for rejection, if the Firm /Vendor fails to comply the provision of clauses of delivery on or before the date mentioned or within such extende d time as may b e granted by the corporation. 15. Any transportation loss shall be responsibility of supplier & have to be borne by them. Any Loss observ e after unpacking at buyer’s end shall be replaced by the vendor at it’s own cost. 16. The delivered item should exactly match with Technical specification as mentioned in GeM contract & as per approved Sample, failing to which LIC have sole right to reject the consignment / Imposed appropri ate penalty/ Blacklist the firm & apart from seizer of EMD Amount. . 3.
